events.invalidation: The holds fail if cash policy rates themselves rise toward the March 2027 implied fixings, or if the Bank of Canada outcome implies a path beyond a one-move catch-up toward the 2.50 percent poll and March continues to reprice higher rather than converge. A lasting oil-driven inflation backup that is clearly more than a brief headline wobble would also cut the carry case. Coupon-curve, euro, and yen marks are absent from the tape and are not treated as evidence. Entry, stop, and target remain null.
events.rationale: March 2027 Canadian and Australian overnight-index forwards still sit well above cash, so the existing receives are paid to wait if policy undershoots those implied paths. Session weakness in crude weakens the inflation-backup story that would threaten those holdings; it is a reason to stay patient, not to exit. This week's Federal Reserve meeting and a Bank of Canada poll at 2.50 percent argue against adding risk, not against keeping the positions that already harvest the extra hike premium. Spot currency is the worse expression: buying the Canadian dollar would pay the United States short-rate gap, while the rate contracts isolate the mispriced path.
